[BEGIN]
module TopModule (
    input  logic a,
    input  logic b,
    input  logic c,
    input  logic d,
    input  logic e,
    output logic [24:0] out
);

    assign out = {
        ~(a ^ a), ~(a ^ b), ~(a ^ c), ~(a ^ d), ~(a ^ e),
        ~(b ^ a), ~(b ^ b), ~(b ^ c), ~(b ^ d), ~(b ^ e),
        ~(c ^ a), ~(c ^ b), ~(c ^ c), ~(c ^ d), ~(c ^ e),
        ~(d ^ a), ~(d ^ b), ~(d ^ c), ~(d ^ d), ~(d ^ e),
        ~(e ^ a), ~(e ^ b), ~(e ^ c), ~(e ^ d), ~(e ^ e)
    };

endmodule
[DONE]
